avoid: Pulling too hard on hands in the circle
children.game_version: The 'Echo' game: the leader does a single step, the children must 'echo' with a double step.

avoid: High arm positions if shoulder mobility is limited
seniors.seated_version: Perform the 7/8 rhythm with foot taps; tap right-left-right for the 'double' variation.
seniors.standing_version: Reduce the travel of the steps; perform the back variation as a small weight shift rather than a full step.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slow the music to 100 BPM; keep steps under 6 inches.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hand hold at shoulder height ('W' position) or joined downwards ('V' position)
movement_profile.footwork: Alternating single steps and double steps backward within the 7/8 meter
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular progression moving to the right
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stable torso with slight bounce in the knees
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to ground; lead dancer may perform small leaps

signature_moves.description: A variation where the dancer takes two steps backward instead of continuing the forward progression
signature_moves.name: Double step back

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Losing the 7/8 count during the backward step transition

music_profile.sound_description: A bright, driving 7/8 rhythm led by a melodic clarinet, featuring the specific 'Stin Apano Geitonia' melody which dictates the step changes.

basic_steps: Step forward with the right foot on the long beat (count 1-2-3)
Step forward with the left foot (count 4-5)
Step forward with the right foot (count 6-7)
Execute a single step variation as described in sources
Execute a double step back variation as described in sources
teaching.level_notes: Requires familiarity with the Kalamatiano 7/8 rhythm before attempting the back-step variations.
